rule: Required Tenders and the end of draft rights by draft year (1999 CBA Art. X §3 and Art. I (vv); 2005 FAQ Q43 and Q102): see runtime/draft_rights.py.

tenders.terms: a one-year contract offer (at the minimum salary)
tenders.basis: Miami's routine Required Tender to each pick it still holds unsigned on his deadline (2005 CBA, FAQ Q102): no signing and no trade of his rights by 2005-09-05 in the closed 2005 summer market record (career/Dwyane_Wade/2004-05/10_Free_Agency/free_agency_2005.json); the market lists him out of the league (no real 2005-06 role), and the rollover carries every Miami pick left unsigned as Miami's draft rights; recorded 2005-09-30 by runtime/draft_rights.record_tenders

rights_ended.basis: Miami's exclusive rights ended unsigned at the 2005 draft (1999 CBA Art. X §3(a); 1999 FAQ Q40); runtime/draft_rights.end_rights
